name: Seafile
description: Seafile Community Edition is a self-hosted file sync and sharing platform with libraries, versioning, sharing, and web access.
short_desc: Self-hosted file sync and sharing platform.
author: Seafile Ltd.

form_fields.label: Seafile hostname
form_fields.hint: Public hostname for Seafile, without https://.

form_fields.label: Seafile protocol
form_fields.hint: Use https when Seafile is exposed through Runtipi, Tailscale Serve, or another TLS reverse proxy.

form_fields.label: Admin password
form_fields.hint: Initial Seafile admin password. Used only on first startup.

form_fields.label: Database root password
form_fields.hint: MariaDB root password. Used by Seafile to create its databases/users on first startup.

form_fields.label: Seafile database password
form_fields.hint: Password for the seafile MariaDB user.

form_fields.label: JWT private key
form_fields.hint: Random secret at least 32 characters long. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

form_fields.label: Redis password
form_fields.hint: Optional password for the internal Redis cache. Leave empty to run Redis without auth on the private app network.
